_comment: Engines baked from upstream Strata (github.com/Niko1221/Strata), built on vega; weights are NOT part of this payload. One binary per (backend, GPU family) because Strata has no dlopen backend system.

strata-hip-rdna.isa_floor: avx (STRATA_ISA_FLOOR=avx; starts on any Sandy Bridge or newer CPU)

strata-sycl-dg2.isa_floor: none - the SYCL (Arc) project has no ISA-floor option, so its host code needs AVX2

strata-sycl-xe2.isa_floor: none - the SYCL (Arc) project has no ISA-floor option, so its host code needs AVX2

hip.glibc_floor: GLIBC_2.38 (loads on noble; z820b's Debian/Ubuntu 7.1.1 packages need 2.43 and were rejected)
hip.proven: runs with ROCM_PATH=/nonexistent and only this bundle on LD_LIBRARY_PATH; ldd -r clean; no library loaded from outside the bundle
hip.slim_alternative: TheRock wheels (ROCm 7.10.0a, 600 MB, glibc 2.17-2.27) cover the gfx110X family only - kept on the build host, not shipped
hip.source: AMD ROCm 7.1.1 - the runtime the engine was compiled against (build host /opt/rocm-7.1.1)

oneapi.not_included: libsycl-jit.so and an AOT acm-* build: this IGC rejects the -ze-opt-greater-than-4GB-buffer-required option an A-series AOT build needs, so A-series uses the JIT engine
oneapi.proven: sycl-ls against this bundle alone lists [level_zero:gpu] Intel(R) Arc(TM) Pro B70 Graphics
oneapi.source: Intel oneAPI 2026.1.1 (/opt/intel/oneapi on the build host)

exit_codes.0: at least one vendor path READY
exit_codes.1: no supported card on this box
exit_codes.2: a path is present but BROKEN - an image bug

selftest.needs_weights_for: --pack DIR: tokens must be produced AND coherent; no flag-only invocation reaches a backend because arguments are parsed first
proves_without_weights: binary loads and links against its own bundled runtime
the detected family's code object is inside the binary
the bundled rocBLAS/hipBLASLt kernels cover that family
